Momcozy · AI says:

I understand why you’d want clear options if a Momcozy product doesn’t work out—especially after previous disappointments! You generally have three paths:

1. Returns
Request a return within 30 days of receiving the order.
The item must be brand new, unused, unopened, and in its original packaging.
Return all accessories and free gifts, with your receipt or order confirmation.
You’re responsible for return shipping, and original shipping fees are non-refundable.
Clearance items and non-Momcozy products aren’t eligible.
After approval, refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days under one policy, or within 3 business days after inspection under the global policy.
2. Exchanges
For non-quality issues, such as an incorrect size, unused products may be exchanged within 30 days of receipt; return shipping is your responsibility.
For defects during the warranty period, submit a quality-related request.
Exchanges require a request through the Return Center, approval, and shipment as instructed.
3. Warranty Support

Online coverage begins on the delivery date. Electrical products, including breast pumps, generally have a 2-year warranty in Canada, the United States, Europe excluding Spain, and other countries, and 3 years in Spain. Coverage applies to material or workmanship defects during normal use.

If covered, Momcozy first provides free replacement parts. If that doesn’t resolve the issue or the main unit is affected, a new product of the same model may be provided. Exclusions include normal wear, misuse, unauthorized repairs or modifications, non-genuine accessories, and purchases through unauthorized channels.

Start through the Return Center for returns or exchanges, or sign in to My Account for warranty and account details.
